changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS openworkflow_snapshot.snapshots (persistence_id text, sequence_nr bigint, timestamp bigint, ser_id int, ser_manifest text, snapshot_data blob, snapshot blob, meta_ser_id int, meta_ser_manifest text, meta blob, PRIMARY KEY (persistence_id, sequence_nr)) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (sequence_nr DESC) AND gc_grace_seconds = 864000 AND compaction = {'class': 'SizeTieredCompactionStrategy'}

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS openworkflow_projection.offset_store (projection_name text, partition int, projection_key text, offset text, manifest text, last_updated timestamp, PRIMARY KEY ((projection_name, partition), projection_key))

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS openworkflow_projection.projection_management (projection_name text, partition int, projection_key text, paused boolean, last_updated timestamp, PRIMARY KEY ((projection_name, partition), projection_key))
